belay.1: On the pale slabs, at a good stance just below the steeper band of darker rock above.
belay.3: On a large talus ledge, reached by climbing the rib on the right side of the bowl.
belay.5: At the top of the scrambly gully, on a solid stance.
belay.7: On a good ledge on the prow, at the top of the left-facing corner.
belay.9: On a large ledge, at the top of the thin corner, short steep section, ramp and second corner.
belay.10: At the top of the low-angle loose face.
